title: OpenSpecLib: an open format and toolkit for spectral libraries
description:
OpenSpecLib is a Python toolkit that ingests public spectral libraries (USGS Spectral Library Version 7, ECOSTRESS, EcoSIS and others), validates them, and publishes them in the OpenSpecLib Format: one self-describing Apache Parquet file per collection, with inline wavelength axes, required quantity and measurement geometry, NaN for missing values, and SPDX licences.

This archive is a snapshot of the source repository at a tagged release: the code (MIT licence), the format specification, its machine-readable schemas, and the documentation. The spectral data files are published as GitHub release assets and on Hugging Face; each collection keeps the licence of its source library, recorded in the file's footer metadata.
